heroHeading: Your local outdoor power equipment shop
heroSubheading: We stock, service, and repair everything you need to keep your equipment running.
aboutHtml:
STIHL SHOP Dunedin is run by Daniel Marsh and Michelle Golder. We stock a wide range of outdoor power equipment from brands including STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Honda, and more. Whether you're maintaining your own gear or looking for something new, we have what you need.

We do more than just sell equipment. Our workshop services and repairs all types of outdoor power equipment and small engines. Bring in what you own, no matter the brand, and we'll help you keep it in top shape. We're also here to offer honest advice about what will work best for your needs.

Pop in and say hello. We're here to help you get the right gear and keep it running well.
